issues.description: On the exterior clocktower (ext-1, ext-2), the `clock` prop at `[0, 16.0, 1.92]` appears shifted near the top edge of the circular housing (`radius: 1.65` centered at `y: 16.0`) because the `clock` prop's pivot or geometry is offset or smaller than the custom backing.
issues.fix: Center the `clock` prop properly inside the circular surround or match the surround cylinders (`pos: [0, 16.6, 1.72]`, `radiusTop: 1.1`, `radiusBottom: 1.1`) to the actual rendered position and size of the `clock` prop.

issues.description: The east, west, and north (back) walls of both the 3-storey brick tower and the front annex hall are completely windowless blank brick boxes (visible in ext-2 and ext-video 00:01–00:06), violating DESIGN.md ('Avoid: blank flat walls, windowless boxes').
issues.fix: Add recessed framed windows with sills and mullions to the east and west faces of the tower (`x = ±4.02`, `y = 7.4, 11.4`) and the east/west faces of the annex (`x = ±5.82`, `y = 3.1`), plus clock faces or louvered vents on the east/west/north faces of the 4th clock level (`y = 16.0`).

issues.description: Indoor `lamp_floor` props are placed outside on the front porch (`pos: [-2.4, 0, 8.6]` and `[2.4, 0, 8.6]`), which looks unrealistic for a civic building exterior.
issues.fix: Replace the two exterior `lamp_floor` props with `plant_tall` or `pot` props in planters flanking the porch, and use wall-mounted lantern geometry on the porch pilasters.

issues.description: The `sign` (`pos: [0, 4.55, 7.75]`, `width: 6.4`) has very low text contrast ('OFFICE HOURS' is washed out by the point light at `[0, 3.9, 8.3]`) and overlaps the inner front annex windows at `wx = -2.2, 2.2`.
issues.fix: Reduce the sign width to `4.6` or raise it to `y: 4.85`, and move or lower the porch point light (`pos: [0, 3.25, 8.1]`, `intensity: 0.8`) so it does not wash out the sign.

issues.description: In the interior (`int-1`, `int-2`, `int-3`), the room feels sparse and cavernous rather than a 'cozy study': a huge empty rug (`6.6 × 4.8`) sits in the middle with two small armchairs perched only on its far north edge, leaving most of the central floor empty.
issues.fix: Bring the consultation desk forward to `z: -3.2` and the two armchairs to `z: -1.4` with a small low side/coffee table between or beside them so they anchor the study rug, and add more tall bookshelves along the north, east, and west walls plus a reading lounge corner in the south-east.

issues.description: The wall-mounted chalkboard question marks (`chalkboard_area` at `x: -8.78`) have their stem boxes (`z: qz`) misaligned with the torus hook and appear backwards/broken in `int-2`.
issues.fix: Adjust the torus rotation and arc so the question mark curves open to the left/bottom properly and connects cleanly into the vertical stem box above the dot, and also place a second set of question marks directly onto the freestanding `whiteboard` prop face or frame the chalkboard prominently on the north wall so it is visible from the entrance.

keep: Clear 3-storey brick tower + 4th clock level + front annex hall silhouette matching the brief

Grandfather/pendulum wall clock feature behind the lead consultation desk
Clean collider setup and probe score of 1.0 with zero console or TSC errors
